title: Update pyyaml to 5.1 due to security issue
description:
GitHub keeps warning about a security issue.  I'd like that to go away by either us dismissing the vulnerability or fixing the vulnerability.  [Alert Link](https://github.com/rstudio/influxdb_backup/network/alert/requirements.txt/pyyaml/open)


https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-18342
> In PyYAML before 4.1, the yaml.load() API could execute arbitrary code. In other words, yaml.safe_load is not used.

I do not know the implications to this project by changing `pyyaml` from v3.11 to v5.1.

https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/master/CHANGES

cc @cbarraford

title: Add sha1 checksum verification
description: When getting the chunks for influxdb, calc the checksum and write to a file. This is used later to verify the file hasn't been tampered with.

title: Add ability to restore backed up files
Stream directly to disk
description: This change is an optimzation. It uses chunked responses from influx and writes those chunks as lines in a text file. This should, in theory, allow us to backup massive quanities of data without needing to use much memory server or client side.
